attr.title: NVForever 0.3 (experimental)
attr.desc: Native ARM64 NVForever port for TrimUI Smart Pro. Includes optional developer tools, idle-work optimizations and diagnostics. Requires separately owned Fallout: New Vegas PC game data. Performance is experimental and scene-dependent.
attr.inst: Requires your own Fallout: New Vegas PC Data folder in nvforever/game/Data and a 2 GB swap file (sh nvforever/setup-swap.sh 2048, once). Saves and user config in nvforever/home are kept on update. Developer menu off by default; enable with home/dev-menu.ini. TrimUI Smart Pro only. See nvforever/README.txt.
